plan.summary: BRO-4666: weekly running costs that disagree with or lack their citation. Gatsby's cited producer interview says more than $900,000 a week but the record holds $850,000. Two Strangers ($480,577) and Harry Potter ($1M) are labeled trade-reported with no source text, so /biz now shows them as estimates; cite the articles already in each record's sources.
steps: The Great Gatsby: weeklyRunningCost 850000 -> 900000, matching its own cited source (Gordon Cox interview with Chunsoo Shin). It stays flagged as an estimate because the source says 'more than'.
Two Strangers: cite Forbes (Marc Hershberg, Nov 17, 2025), already in its sources, for the $480,577 weekly cost.
Harry Potter and the Cursed Child: cite Broadway Journal (Philip Boroff, Dec 16, 2025), already in its sources, for weekly operating expenses exceeding $1 million.
